item.title: Europe needs to stress-test the infrastructure behind its emergency oil supply
item.description: Europe should not need an emergency to test the security of its oil supply infrastructure, writes Ivo Hlaváček, former Slovak ambassador and former director-general at the Slovak Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Saipem Signs New Preliminary Contract for Rovuma LNG
item.description: A consortium of Belgium's Jan De Nul and Italy's Saipem signed a letter of intent with ExxonMobil for the upstream infrastructure of the planned Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique.

item.title: Oil prices poised to end week above $100 for first time since May
item.description: Oil prices declined on 11 September, Friday but remained positioned to end the week over $100 per barrel, marking the first weekly close at this level since mid-May.

item.title: TotalEnergies makes new oil discovery in Angola’s Block 17
item.description: TotalEnergies has disclosed making the Acacia-5 near-by oil discovery on Block 17 offshore Angola, with plans to bring the new field into production just three months after its discovery in June 2026.

item.title: Saipem, Jan De Nul sign LoI for Mozambique Rovuma LNG project
